Select chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for molecules in document CHEMBL1139796. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to enforce availability of canonical_smiles. Filter by doc_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1139796'. Return distinct rows. Order results by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
